sample_unit: manually contoured CBCT images from 39 LACC patients
unlisted_practices: Automated CBCT segmentation combined with a quantitative standard operating procedure to select the plan-of-the-day in adaptive radiotherapy
Using the AI tool as a second observer to reduce the number of trained radiographers needed for plan selection

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an AI-driven plan-of-the-day (POTD) assessment workflow for adaptive radiotherapy using CBCT segmentation and quantitative standard operating procedures, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice comparators.
